description: Priority Index Database-Medellin (Colombia) is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Ekin Gultepe, University of Canterbury (canterbury.ac.nz). 82 reinforced concrete buildings from 30 schools of Medellín, Itagüí and Sabaneta (Colombia) were surveyed during the year 2013 by a group of civil engineer students and a master student from the Universidad EAFIT. All of the analysed buildings are moment resisting frames with masonry infill. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 3 top-level files (CSV). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2pq14. Keywords: Priority Index, Medellin, earthquake engineerring, hassan index, reinforced concrete, wall index. Published 2017-07-20. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
